rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice when something is easy, uncomplicated, or has no difficulty.

example.english: This route is straightforward; you just need to follow the map.
example.traditional: 呢條路線好簡單，跟住地圖行就得。
example.jyutping: nei1 tiu4 lou6 sin3 hou2 gaan2 daan1 gan1 zyu6 dei6 tou4 haang4 zau6 dak1

rows.note: Use this for someone or something that communicates in a direct, forthright way rather than indirectly.

example.english: They are very straightforward and do not beat around the bush.
example.traditional: 佢講嘢好直接，唔會拐彎抹角。
example.jyutping: keoi5 gong2 je5 hou2 zik6 zip3 m4 wui5 gwaai2 waan1 mut3 gok3

rows.note: Use this when the emphasis is on being frank, open, or sincere, especially about personal feelings or facts.

example.english: To be straightforward, I do not have much confidence in this arrangement.
example.traditional: 坦白講，我對呢個安排冇乜信心。
example.jyutping: taan2 baak6 gong2 ngo5 deoi3 ni1 go3 on1 paai4 mou5 mat1 seon3 sam1
